title: EAO Focused Training - The European Association for Osseointegration
html:
EAO Focused Training:
Soft Tissue Management

Advanced hands-on training

Develop your Soft Tissue Management skills with three clinicians who are among the most respected in implant dentistry.

Register now

Immersive, expert-led training in

Soft Tissue Management

Join a focused three-day educational experience designed to translate evidence-based knowledge into practical clinical application.

Guided by Markus Hürzeler, Oscar Gonzalez Martin and Giovanni Zucchelli, participants will explore soft tissue management from surgical, restorative and peri-implant perspectives, gaining practical techniques grounded in the latest scientific evidence.

With an intimate learning environment, practical training and opportunities to exchange directly with faculty and peers, the programme supports learning that can be applied in clinical practice.

Your course fee includes accommodation at VIP Grand Lisboa and full-board meals, creating a focused and enriching experience throughout the three-day programme.

Overview of the workshops on each day

Markus Hürzeler

Soft Tissue 
Management 
during Implant Therapy

15th April 2027

Day 1 – Programme

8:30 – 10:00 – Understanding autogenous connective tissue graft. Where to harvest and why?

10:00 – 10:30 – Break

10:30 – 11:30 – Soft tissue management in the esthetic zone for dental implants with ideal bone situation

11:30 – 12:30 – Soft tissue management in the esthetic zone for dental implants with missing bone

12:30 – 13:30 – Lunch

13:30 – 15:30 – Hands-on: Harvesting autogenous connective tissue
a) tuberosity graft (new thoughts)
b) subepithelium connective tissue graft (single incision)

15:30 – 17:30 – Hands-On: Peninsular flap in combination with tunneling and saloon door technique a new way of soft tissue management with dental implants in the esthetic zone

Óscar González Martín

Soft Tissue 
Management 
with Prosthesis

16th April 2027

Day 2 – Programme

8:30 – 10:00 – Essential principles of implant therapy and provisionalization in the esthetic zone + Foundational principles and clinical applications – Soft tissue management around implants

10:00 – 10:30 – Break

10:30 – 11:00 – New technologies for optimal communication with the laboratory technician regarding the peri-implant soft tissue architecture

11:00 – 12:00 – Decision Tree for the Management of Complex Cases in the Aesthetic Zone: Ortho-Perio-Implant therapy

12:00 – 13:30 – Lunch

13:30 – 15:30 – Hands-on: Provisionalization on Immediate Implants

15:30 – 16:00 – Break

16:00 – 18:00 – Hands-on: Provisionalization on Delayed Implants

Giovanni Zucchelli

Soft Tissue Management of
Recessions around Implants

17th April 2027

Day 3 – Programme

8:30 – 10:00 – Soft tissue management around implants in the esthetic area. The suprabony component of the root

10:00 – 10:30 – Break

10:30 – 11:30 – Keratinized tissue height and soft tissue thickness in the prevention and treatment of gingival recession around implants

11:30 – 12:30 – Increase in soft tissue thickness during immediate/delayed implant placement

12:30 – 13:30 – Lunch

13:30 – 15:30 – Hands-on: Coronally Advanced Flap for single/multiple gingival recessions/Mucosal dehiscences

15:30 – 17:30 – Hands-on: Keratinized mucosa augmentation around dental implants


Who benefits from this course?

Dentists looking to specialise 

Master the latest soft tissue management techniques to address complex implant cases.

Clinicians aiming to refine their skills

Gain proficiency in advanced implant dentistry methods through hands-on training with the newest technologies.

Professionals seeking hands-on training

The course allows you to refine your skills and confidently handle complex implant dentistry procedures.

An all-inclusive package

This EAO Focused Training offers a unique opportunity to combine professional development with relaxation. The 3-day programme will be held in Lisbon, Portugal, allowing you to learn advanced techniques whilst taking in the city’s beautiful scenery.

The course fee includes stunning accommodation at VIP Grand Lisboa and full board meals, ensuring a focused and enriching experience.
